transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net customer billing and account services. My name is Liam. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Liam. I am calling to dispute an outrageous and completely unjustified twelve-pound late payment administration fee that S-Net added to my monthly broadband statement this morning. I made our monthly broadband payment on Friday before the bank holiday weekend, but S-Net's automated billing system failed to process the transaction until Tuesday and penalized me with a late penalty fee!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly look into that late payment charge for you, Zachary. Before we query the automated billing ledger, may I please verify your full billing address and your security question answer?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it is 88 Queens Road, Bristol, BS8 1QU. My security question answer is my favourite film, Casablanca. And my bank payment transaction reference is BACS-7749102.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Zachary, that verifies the billing file. What is the customer account reference number?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The account reference is ACC-339108. Liam, I have been a loyal, uninterrupted S-Net customer for twelve years and I have never missed a single payment deadline in over a decade! I deliberately logged into my online banking at nine o'clock on Friday morning before the Easter bank holiday, transferred the full fifty-four pounds, and received instant confirmation from Barclays Bank! Slapping a twelve-pound penalty fee onto a loyal pensioner's account simply because banks take three business days to clear holiday funds is predatory, greedy, and feels like extortion! I am absolutely furious!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand your acute frustration and anger at seeing an unfair twelve-pound late payment fee when you made the bank transfer in good faith on Friday morning, and having your twelve-year flawless loyalty penalized due to bank holiday clearing delays is unacceptable, so let us review the exact BACS timestamp and remove that penalty charge immediately.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Liam, I really appreciate you recognizing that I paid on time.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am opening the automated payment reconciliation ledger on our Oracle billing platform.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What does the transaction ledger record show?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: At what exact time on Friday morning did your Barclays banking app show the electronic transfer leaving your checking account, Zachary?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The banking receipt shows Friday morning at 09:14 AM with payment reference BACS-7749102.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Our payment clearing gateway records incoming Faster Payments funds settlement on Tuesday morning at 06:30 AM following the holiday.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So because the automated billing cutoff occurred at midnight on Monday, the system triggered an automated penalty?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Did you receive an automated SMS payment reminder on Monday afternoon prior to the billing cutoff, Zachary?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, I never received any text reminder or warning message at all.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The automated billing batch processor flagged the account as overdue at 00:01 AM on Tuesday.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That proves the computer algorithm penalized me six hours before your bank processed the deposit!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Automated billing rules apply administrative fees whenever cleared funds are not posted by invoice due dates.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is absurd! You cannot punish customers for the UK banking system being closed on Easter Monday! Any reasonable person knows banks don't settle on bank holidays!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Are you really too stupid to understand how bank clearing cycles work?! If you want weekend processing, set up a Direct Debit!

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Did you just call me 'stupid'?! You insolent, abusive child! I am a seventy-five-year-old retired university professor! Calling a loyal customer stupid over your company's incompetent billing software is completely intolerable! I demand your employee identification number and your department director's name right now!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I apologize, Zachary. That comment was completely unacceptable. My employee ID is SNET-7782. Let me immediately rectify the charge.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: You will be hearing about this from executive management. Reverse that twelve-pound fee immediately!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I will take direct personal ownership of this dispute, Zachary, and execute an immediate twelve-pound fee reversal credit onto your account ledger.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Process the reversal right now so I can see zero balance.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What was the banking payment transaction reference number from your Barclays transfer receipt, Zachary?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Liam, as I explicitly stated at the start, the reference is BACS-7749102! Why do you keep asking me to repeat reference numbers that I already gave you?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I apologize, Zachary, I had to locate the manual ledger adjustment override field.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Please listen carefully to the information provided.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have entered manual fee adjustment code REV-LATE-FEE for the amount of twelve pounds.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Does the system show the twelve pounds wiped out?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously posting code REV-LATE-FEE zeroes out the administration penalty balance immediately, Zachary.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Let me refresh my S-Net online billing portal account page.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your current ledger balance now displays zero pounds and zero pence with zero arrears.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, the balance is showing zero pounds. The twelve-pound charge has disappeared.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us also check your credit bureau reporting profile to verify that zero negative remarks were logged.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is critical because I will not tolerate any blemish on my perfect credit score.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have confirmed that zero credit bureau reporting flags exist; your payment history remains recorded as one hundred percent on-time and in good standing.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is a huge relief for my financial records.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us set up an automated five-day grace period on your account for future bank holiday weekends, Zachary.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How does that five-day grace period work?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The grace period marker prevents automated late fee triggers for five working days after any calendar invoice due date.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That will completely prevent this bank holiday clearing delay from ever reoccurring.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have permanently activated the five-day payment grace window on your account file.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you, that is a very sensible solution.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us also look at enrolling in monthly Direct Debit so payment transfers execute automatically without requiring manual banking app actions.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I prefer manual transfers so I maintain control over my bank balance, but I appreciate the explanation.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We will maintain your preferred manual payment method with the new grace window enabled, Zachary.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That suits me very well.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us also apply a courtesy loyalty credit of ten pounds to your next monthly bill in recognition of twelve years of continuous service.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: A ten-pound loyalty credit is very kind and appreciated.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have posted the ten-pound loyalty courtesy credit to your next invoice under credit reference CRED-881902.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Credit reference CRED-881902 noted.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The credit will automatically reduce your May statement from fifty-four pounds down to forty-four pounds.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That will be a nice saving on our next bill.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us check your registered email address to ensure you receive updated statement confirmation receipts.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The updated statement receipt showing zero balance just arrived in my inbox.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to reconfirm, the BACS payment receipt reference is BACS-7749102 and your balance is fully settled at zero.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, BACS-7749102 and zero balance. That is completely correct.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am pleased we have reversed the twelve-pound late fee, protected your credit standing, and applied the courtesy credit. Have I answered all of your questions and completely resolved your billing dispute today, Zachary?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes Liam, you resolved the dispute completely, although your earlier remark calling me stupid was completely uncalled for. Thank you for sorting the ledger.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net. Have a wonderful day. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye Liam, thank you for your help.
